hints.title: Net Displacement
hints.text: Observe that moves 'L' and 'R' directly cancel each other out in terms of horizontal position.

hints.title: Flexible Direction
hints.text: Every underscore can be chosen to move in whatever direction maximizes total absolute distance from the starting point.

hints.title: Absolute Value Formulation
hints.text: The furthest distance reachable equals the absolute difference between counts of 'L' and 'R', plus the total count of underscores.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def furthestDistanceFromOrigin(self, moves: str) -> int:
        l = moves.count('L')
        r = moves.count('R')
        blank = moves.count('_')
        return abs(l - r) + blank
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating all 2^k paths for k underscores is exponential and unnecessary.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) extra space using constant-sized counter variables.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize the greedy choice for underscores in constant time after counting.
